versions.changelog:
Initial release of skill-progressive-disclosure-design:

- Provides guidelines on when and how to split SKILL.md into reference files for improved context efficiency.
- Distinguishes between triggering (YAML description) and progressive disclosure (content loading), advising not to conflate them.
- Details three effective axes for splitting skills: variant branch, workflow vs. reference data, and depth tier (common path vs. edge cases), each with explicit trade-offs.
- Outlines anti-patterns for splitting that often fail, such as topic-based splits and splitting solely to reduce line count.
- Recommends keeping SKILL.md monolithic until splitting delivers clear benefits, with guidance on when splitting is justified.
